mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_enterprise_app (app_code, enterprise_code, app_name, app_icon, app_launch_icon) VALUES (#{enterpriseAppModel.appCode}, #{enterpriseAppModel.enterpriseCode}, #{enterpriseAppModel.appName}, #{enterpriseAppModel.appIcon}, #{enterpriseAppModel.appLaunchIcon}) ON CONFLICT (app_code) DO UPDATE SET app_name = EXCLUDED.app_name, app_icon = EXCLUDED.app_icon, app_launch_icon = EXCLUDED.app_launch_icon
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_code, enterprise_code, app_name, app_icon, app_launch_icon, create_time, update_time, delete_flag FROM enterprise_base.t_enterprise_base_enterprise_app WHERE delete_flag = false AND enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} LIMIT 1
